farm.isekai_mahou.blueprint.barn.desc: 9×11 log-framed barn with a triple gate, stalls, hay and lanterns hanging from the ridge beam.
farm.isekai_mahou.blueprint.bridge.desc: 3×15 bridge going forward: log beams, railings, lanterns and pillars every 4 blocks.
farm.isekai_mahou.blueprint.farm_plot.de: 9×9 plot: log frame, farmland around a water source, fence with gate and torches.
farm.isekai_mahou.blueprint.help: Right-click the ground: places the site (the build goes in front of you). Put chests with the blocks near the stake.
7×7 house with log corners, gable roof, windows, chest, crafting table and furnace.
farm.isekai_mahou.blueprint.tower.desc: 16-tall 5×5 stone tower: ladder, two floors, arrow slits and torch-lit battlements.
farm.isekai_mahou.build.busy: You have too many builds running — wait for them to finish.
farm.isekai_mahou.build.missing: Ran out of %s — the build stopped (what was done stays).
farm.isekai_mahou.glyph.no_material: Arcane Construction: hold the block in your off hand (or pick a material with the Wand).
farm.isekai_mahou.hatchery.captured: %s stored in the Hatchery! Feed it to produce.
farm.isekai_mahou.heist.need_silk: The altar is sealed to the ground. Only Silk Touch can pry it loose.
farm.isekai_mahou.heist.not_worthy: The %s shrine doesn't recognize you yet: beat the altar's trial first.
farm.isekai_mahou.heist.success.hint: Place it at your base and give it mana (Mana Batteries nearby): it makes essences over time.
farm.isekai_mahou.heist.trial_active: The trial is running — wait for it to end.
farm.isekai_mahou.hud.undo: Click to undo your last build
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.accelerated_tr: A sapling or seed grows and is harvested by itself, again and again (logs, fruit, crops).
A sapling (any tree, Nether fungi) or a seed/plant (wheat, carrot, pumpkin, sugar cane, bamboo...). Not consumed.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.arcane_hatcher: Bring an animal on a lead and click: it's kept inside and, when fed, produces its drops (leather, wool, eggs...).
Food for the stored animal (wheat, carrots, seeds...) — 1 per cycle.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.arcane_stone_g: Slowly makes stone with mana. With an essence as catalyst it makes ores: Earth (ores), Fire (Nether), Water (sea), Shadow (obsidian and End).
Catalyst (optional): Earth, Fire, Water or Shadow Essence — each lasts 6 cycles.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.channel_hint: Sneak with an empty hand on the machine to channel your own resource.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.elemental_pede: %s Essence Generator: makes essences over time, using mana.
Guardian Core of the same element (optional): 2× faster. Not consumed.
Stolen from an Elemental Shrine with Silk Touch.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.fuel_bonemeal: Bone meal: the next cycle grows 2× faster.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.fuel_list: Mana Crystal 600 · Crystal Block 5400 · Amethyst 80 · Lapis 50 · Glowstone dust 40 · Redstone 25
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.magic_fish_pon: An enchanted pond that fishes by itself: fish, junk and sometimes treasure.
Fishing rod (optional): Lure and Luck of the Sea apply; uses durability.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.mana_line: Mana: Mana Batteries within 8 blocks, crystals in the fuel slot, or sneak with an empty hand to channel your own.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.output_line: Output goes into hoppers/chests below. Redstone pauses it.
farm.isekai_mahou.machine.status.no_anim: No animal (bring one on a lead)
farm.isekai_mahou.site.boosted: Boosted: a Mana Battery within %s blocks (2 mana per block).
farm.isekai_mahou.site.done: "%s" is finished! The blueprint went back to the chest.
farm.isekai_mahou.site.height: The build doesn't fit in the world height here.
farm.isekai_mahou.site.label: %s — %s%%
farm.isekai_mahou.site.no_chest: No chest nearby: put chests with the materials within %s blocks of the stake.
farm.isekai_mahou.site.normal: Tip: a Mana Battery within %s blocks speeds up the build.
farm.isekai_mahou.site.placed: "%s" site placed! Put chests with the materials within %s blocks of the stake.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.bad_material: That block can't be used as material.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.copy_too_big: Area too big to copy (max %s per side).
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.cost: Cost: %s mana per block + the blocks.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.far: You are too far from the marked area.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.help1: Click a block: mark corners · Click the air: run
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.help2: Sneak + click the air: change mode · Sneak + click a block: material
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.help3: Sneak + click a chest: link it (extra blocks, up to 64 blocks away)
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.linked: Chest linked: %s (works up to %s blocks away).
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.mode.copy.hint: Copies the box (up to 16 per side) to the clipboard.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.mode.fill.hint: Fills the whole marked box with the material.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.mode.floor.hint: Covers the bottom layer of the box.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.mode.paste.hint: Pastes the clipboard on the targeted block, rotated to face you.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.mode.swap.hint: Swaps every block of the 1st corner's type for the material.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.mode.undo.hint: Undoes your last build (gives the blocks back).
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.mode.wall.hint: Raises the 4 walls of the box (no roof or floor).
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.no_clip: Empty clipboard: use Copy mode first.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.no_material: No material: hold a block in your off hand or sneak + click a block.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.nothing: Nothing to do in that area.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.paste_aim: Aim at a block to paste.
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.swap_same: Swap: the 1st corner must be the block type to replace (and differ from the material).
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.too_big: Area too big (max %s per side and %s blocks).
farm.isekai_mahou.wand.undo_dimension: Your last build was in another dimension.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arcane_extract.desc: Pulls the hit block (and matching ones nearby with Expand) straight into your inventory. With Silk Touch it comes out whole — even the Elemental Shrine altars.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arcane_fill.desc: Fills holes, pits and ponds in a sphere below the impact with the material. Expand: bigger sphere.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arcane_floor.desc: Covers the ground around the impact with the material, only where empty (quick bridges and platforms). Expand: bigger area.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arcane_transmute.desc: Swaps nearby blocks of the hit block's type for the material; the old ones come back as items. Expand: bigger area.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arcane_wall.desc: Raises a wall of your material where it hits. Expand: wider · Amplify: taller. Uses blocks from your inventory/linked chest.
